scope: Test whether approximate meshWave wall distance on the curved NACA 0012 mesh is a dominant source of the downstream SSTm skin-friction excess.

basis.observed_profile: OpenFOAM-to-CFL3D Cf is near unity over the forward chord and grows to approximately 1.29 over x/c 0.8 to 0.98, while the aligned flat-plate SSTm subsystem passed.
basis.openfoam_documentation: OpenFOAM documents meshWave as approximate on skewed or non-orthogonal meshes and provides an exact nearest-patch method.
basis.fixed_solution_gradient_audit: Removing the cell gradient limiter changes summed nut*S2 in retained airfoil owner cells by only 0.0023 percent and is not a plausible dominant mechanism.

candidate.single_change: Replace wallDist method meshWave with exact.
candidate.same_transport: exact Sutherland viscosity and molecular Prandtl number 0.72
candidate.initialization: same-grid restart from the frozen source final fields

required_gates: all existing final and final-window residual limits

mechanism_test.direction: Candidate Cd and downstream Cf discrepancy must decrease.
mechanism_test.basis: Sum of frozen finest-pair, scheme, and iterative Cd allowances; this is a diagnostic materiality threshold, not a replacement acceptance threshold.
mechanism_test.skin_friction: Repeat the pinned CFL3D Cf comparison and report chordwise bins, with emphasis on x/c 0.4 to 0.98.
mechanism_test.decision: If the candidate passes all gates, moves in the expected direction, and exceeds the materiality threshold while improving downstream Cf, wall distance is supported as a correction mechanism. Otherwise preserve it as a null or failed sensitivity and do not revalidate Gate 3 on this basis.

acceptance_effect: This single sensitivity cannot accept the benchmark or rocket workflow. A supported correction must still repeat the complete Gate 3 suite under the main remediation plan.
